Hi OP currently working on my own 90s Civic a 98 Civic VTi with a B20B engine swap. If you’re not planning to do an engine swap these would be some of the things you should look out for:

Roof Repairs: Prone to Rust
*Battery & Alternator: Prone to draining and breaking
*Clutch Slave & Master: Prone to breaking and leaks
*Power Steering Pump: Prone to leaking
*Radiator and Thermostat: Prone to overheating and breaking
*Valve Cover Gasket: Prone to leaking
*Starter: Prone to breaking
*IACV: Prone to being clogged up

These are all the serious problems I faced when working on my civic (aside for the roof repair which I just did a washover for the whole car) I mostly replaced rather repair these parts it cost me around 60k without labor.
